NOTICE
It is notified for information of all the candidates who have submitted their application forms
in response to Advertisement Notice No. 05 of 2025, dated July 01, 2025 for the post of Deputy
Director, Directorate of Physical Education & Sports that the provisional list of applicants along
with the deficiencies, if any, is given in Annexure I (Open) & Annexure
Notice. Further, if a candidate finds any discrepancy regarding his/her status, he/she may
approach to the office of the Recruitment Section of the University of Kashmir with
documentary proof by or before 07.10.2025
No claim, whatsoever, after the last date for clearance of deficiencies shall be entertained.
Further, the interview for the said posts will be conducted only when the minimum of three
candidates are, eligible in each category.
